title: Uncloud 2026: 10 Years of Breaking the Binary
excerpt: Uncloud's tenth year: fourteen installations running as one continuous ninety-minute loop through the Beatrixgebouw, four nights of live performance, and two anniversaries.
description:
Uncloud's tenth year, 1 to 11 October 2026. Fourteen installations in the Beatrixgebouw beside Utrecht Centraal, four evenings of live performance, a concert night with Modulation. at De Helling, and a closing night at EKKO, which turned forty the same year.
I co-curate and organise Uncloud with Skander Jaïbi and Ines Kooli. For this edition I also built the main control system for the exhibition and ran the technical production, including arranging the sponsors.
With Rafael Anton Irisarri I closed the exhibition with Points of Inaccessibility, and we played the live version on 4 October. The work came out of his residency at Uncloud in the former Pieter Baan Centrum and was released on Black Knoll Editions.
> For this edition we did not want to place different disciplines side by side, but to create an experience in which those distinctions are no longer relevant.
> The fourteen works are not shown as separate installations. They hand over to one another and flow into each other: one continuous environment of scenography, installation, light and sound. Ninety minutes, no fixed beginning, several ways in, and every work a link in the same chain.
> Ten years spent looking for the places where categories stop working: between concert and exhibition, between physical and digital, between spectator and participant. This edition asks what is left when you leave those lines out altogether.
